name: Whirling Whimpus
description: A 'fearsome critter' of North American lumberjack tall tales: a gorilla-shaped beast that spins so fast it becomes invisible, mistaken for a small dust devil or whirlwind, and crushes anything that strays into its path.
origin: A tall-tale beast of the North American lumberwoods, particularly the Appalachian Mountains and the Great Lakes / eastern logging regions in which the fearsome-critters tradition flourished c.1880–1940. Often associated specifically with Tennessee and the southern Appalachians.
